core_topics: React component lifecycle and hooks (useEffect, useCallback, useMemo)
State management patterns (Context API, Redux, Zustand, Jotai)
Performance optimisation (memoization, code splitting, lazy loading)
Accessibility (ARIA roles, keyboard navigation, screen reader support)
TypeScript with React (generics, discriminated unions, strict typing)
CSS architecture (CSS Modules, styled-components, design tokens)
Testing (React Testing Library, Vitest/Jest, mocking fetch)
Build tooling (Vite, Webpack, tree shaking, bundle analysis)
red_flags: Cannot explain why a component is re-rendering unexpectedly
Uses useEffect to synchronise state that could be derived
Cannot describe how to measure and improve Core Web Vitals
Treats TypeScript as just 'JavaScript with types' without understanding structural typing
Cannot explain the difference between controlled and uncontrolled components

calibration_examples.description: Discusses tradeoffs between approaches, mentions performance implications, references real problems they've solved.
Knows the concepts but cannot apply them to novel problems. Good at common patterns only.
Relies on tutorials/cargo-culting without understanding the underlying reasons. Cannot debug under pressure.

suggested_questions: Explain the rules of hooks. Why do they exist, and what happens if you break them?
You have a list of 10,000 items rendered in React. It's janky. Walk me through your optimisation approach.
What's the difference between useCallback and useMemo? Give me a case where using useMemo would be a mistake.
How would you implement a global notification/toast system in a React app without a library?
Describe how you'd structure state for a multi-step checkout form with validation.
What does React's reconciliation algorithm do, and how do keys affect it?
Walk me through how you'd make a data table accessible to keyboard and screen reader users.
